planets.name: CoRoT-7 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of CoRoT-7 with a 0.854-day year, found in 2009.

text.card: CoRoT-7 b was found in 2009 by CoRoT as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around CoRoT-7. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2009, disc_facility CoRoT, sy_pnum 3; pl_orbper 0.85359165, pl_radj 0.15, pl_bmassj 0.01282637

quotes.title: CoRoT-7b
quotes.card: CoRoT-7b is an exoplanet orbiting the star CoRoT-7 in the constellation of Monoceros, 520 light-years from the Earth.
quotes.introduction: It was first detected photometrically by the French-led CoRoT mission and reported in February 2009.
